meta.title: [Testing] Rework Catalyst Test Runner to use startup arguments instead of UI navigation
meta.body_summary: Rework Catalyst Test Runner to pass test names via startup arguments (environment variables) instead of UI navigation, eliminating brittle keyboard interactions and reducing test overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot PR to replace UI-based test navigation with startup arguments for Catalyst; no review, closed after ~25 days without merge following a maintainer mention.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 57 changed lines across 3 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance PR that would normally be low-risk, but it was closed without merge, likely due to process factors rather than size.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or substantive feedback; only a single maintainer comment '@copilot' at the time of closure after ~25 days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminates UI navigation overhead, reduces test latency, improves reliability by avoiding timing-dependent keyboard interactions.
review_details.rejection_signals: No explicit rejection; PR closed after extended inactivity with a copilot mention.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Test infrastructure optimization PR with no review engagement; closed after weeks of inactivity, indicating process boundary (lack of maintainer bandwidth or priority) rather than technical rejection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No evidence of manual testing or verification of performance claim; no benchmark or profiling.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any fix cycle; no regressions explicitly identified.

core_change_summary.description: Added ProcessArguments support to AppiumCatalystApp to pass test names as startup environment variables; modified the test host app (MauiProgram.cs) to read 'test' env var and navigate directly; updated _IssuesUITest to set test config args for Catalyst and reset per test.
change_trajectory: Implementation commit: added startup argument logic to AppiumCatalystApp, host app environment variable reading, and Catalyst-specific test config in _IssuesUITest (+47 lines total).
Formatting commit: minor whitespace adjustments in MauiProgram.cs and _IssuesUITest.cs.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer mentioned '@copilot' without further instruction or review.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue, made three commits (plan, implementation, formatting), review requested, no feedback until closure by maintainer with @copilot mention after ~25 days.
